meta_description: Electrician Nottingham. Fast electrical repairs, installations and inspections. NICEIC registered. Same-day callouts available. Call 07883 854063 today.
hero_subhead: Electrical fault in Wollaton or Nottingham? We arrive fast, diagnose on the spot, and fix most problems the same day.
services_subhead: From urgent fault repairs and replacements to full rewires and safety inspections, we handle domestic and small commercial work.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Blown fuses, tripped electrics, dead sockets — we diagnose and fix the fault same day. No call-out charge if you book within 24 hours.

services.title: Boiler and Heating Electrics
services.desc: Faulty heating controls, broken immersion heater, or thermal switch issues? We repair or replace heating electrical components quickly.

services.title: Full House Rewires
services.desc: Old wiring, dangerous sockets, or planning a renovation? We strip and rewire your home to modern Building Regs, with full certification.

services.title: Periodic Electrical Inspections
services.desc: Landlord safety certificates, pre-purchase surveys, or routine PAT testing — we test your installation and provide detailed written reports.

services.title: New Circuits and Installations
services.desc: Adding a new kitchen circuit, installing an EV charging point, or fitting new outdoor sockets — we design and install safely.

services.title: Fusebox and Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Old ceramic fuses, worn contactors, or no RCD protection? We upgrade to a modern, safe unit and test everything thoroughly.

about_pullquote: I started fixing electrics because I was tired of cowboys ripping people off.
about_para_1: I'm a qualified electrician with 18 years' experience in Nottingham. I set up this business because I kept seeing neighbours overcharged for simple fixes. Since then, I've completed over 2,400 jobs — from emergency callouts to full house rewires — and built my reputation on honest pricing and fast, thorough work.
about_para_2: Most of my work comes from repeat customers and word-of-mouth. I turn up on time, explain what's wrong, and only recommend work that's actually needed. If I spot a small issue while I'm there, I tell you straightaway rather than bill for it separately. That's how I'd want to be treated.

reviews.text: Had a complete nightmare with a dodgy fusebox — sparks coming from it. Phoned in the morning, electrician was here by lunchtime. Diagnosed a worn main switch, replaced the whole box, tested everything, all done in two hours. Fair price, very thorough. Can't fault him.
reviews.author: Mike T.

reviews.text: Kitchen electrics weren't working properly after a storm. He came out same day, found a damp connection in the board, dried it out, and tested all the circuits. Explained everything clearly so I understood what had gone wrong. Brilliant, honest service.
reviews.author: Sarah H.

reviews.text: Needed a new RCD fitted and two outdoor sockets for a garden office. Very professional installation, all certified and signed off. Took about three hours, tidy work, and he cleared up after himself. Would use him again without hesitation.
reviews.author: James K.
